0022600089.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons as the Grizzlies host the Utah Jazz. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the most recent meeting came on April 10 in Salt Lake City, where Memphis lost 147-101. Isaiah Stewart is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision for Memphis, while Utah is without Blake Hinson (hamstring strain), Jusuf Nurkic (foot), Tony Bradley (quadriceps), and Trey Alexander (knee), all listed as out.
